package task

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestNormalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []domain.TaskTest{{
		SourceKey: "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question",
		Variants: []domain.TaskTestVariant{
			{SourceKey: "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question.option-a"},
			{SourceKey: "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question.option-b"},
		},
	}}

	if err := normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(tests); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if tests[0].SourceKey != "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question" {
		t.Fatalf("question source key = %q", tests[0].SourceKey)
	}
	if tests[0].Variants[1].SourceKey != "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question.option-b" {
		t.Fatalf("variant source key = %q", tests[0].Variants[1].SourceKey)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeTaskTestSourceKeysRejectsDuplicateKeys(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []domain.TaskTest{{
		SourceKey: "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question",
		Variants:  []domain.TaskTestVariant{{SourceKey: "knowledge-tree.lesson.test.question"}},
	}}

	err := normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(tests)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPrepareTaskTestsResolvesClassificationGroupSourceKey(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []domain.TaskTest{{
		Kind: domain.TaskTestKindClassification,
		Groups: []domain.TaskTestGroup{{
			ID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", SourceKey: "question.group", Order: 1,
		}},
		Variants: []domain.TaskTestVariant{{GroupSourceKey: "question.group", Order: 1}},
	}}

	prepared := prepareTaskTests("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", tests)
	if prepared[0].Variants[0].GroupID != prepared[0].Groups[0].ID {
		t.Fatalf("group reference was not resolved: %+v", prepared[0].Variants[0])
	}
}
